name: SAVIA Deployment Health Check
description: Automatically run deployment diagnostics when critical files are edited

then.prompt: A critical deployment configuration file was just edited. Run the deployment diagnostic to check for issues: python diagnose_deployment.py. If there are any errors, explain what needs to be fixed and suggest corrections.

name: SAVIA Script Validation
description: Automatically verify deployment scripts before they are used

then.prompt: A deployment script was just edited. Verify the script syntax and logic are correct. Check for: 1) Proper error handling, 2) Correct variable usage, 3) Safe command execution, 4) Proper logging. If there are any issues, suggest fixes.

name: SAVIA Pre-Push Deployment Check
description: Automatically run quick diagnostics before pushing code

then.prompt: Before pushing code, run a quick deployment health check. Execute: python diagnose_deployment.py. Report any critical issues that would prevent deployment. If all checks pass, confirm the code is ready to push.

name: SAVIA Monitoring Status Check
description: Check monitoring daemon status after deployment

then.prompt: Deployment task completed. Verify monitoring is running: ./monitoring_daemon.sh status. If monitoring is not running, start it: ./monitoring_daemon.sh start. Report the monitoring status.

name: SAVIA API Test on Save
description: Test API endpoints when backend code is modified

then.prompt: Backend code was modified. Test the equipment creation endpoint: curl -X POST http://localhost:8001/api/equipements -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"Nom":"TEST","Type":"Scanner CT","Domaine":"Radiologie","Fabricant":"Test","Modele":"Test","NumSerie":"TEST","Client":"Centre Principal","Statut":"Opérationnel","DateInstallation":"2024-01-01","DernieresMaintenance":"2024-01-01"}'. Report if the endpoint is working correctly.
